facts.fact: The CNPD, headed by president Faustino Varela, delivered its 2023 annual activity report to the president of the National Assembly, as the law requires.
The CNPD president said the commission decided 297 processes out of 326 requests during 2023.
The authority's head signed the statutes of the Lusophone Data Protection Network on 20 March 2025 as a founding member, so Cabo Verde's authority is in post.
